admission.justification: Removing the prose alone would hide failures and print no path to the report; keeping a failure line alone still leaves the report unreachable; opening the report alone does not keep the strip free of reply text or its height constant; and a bound row that started a second agent or guessed a preparation outcome would break the same one-row truth. Only together do they keep the developer-visible defect gone while the report, the failures and the start's own outcome remain reachable.

guarantee: The role launcher remains a constant-height row of controls with no execution prose: it starts exactly its admitted canonical selection, shows the shared preparation truth and keeps failures in one actionable line; Result preserves the selected execution’s exact request identity and opens its report in the existing reader. Ordinary singleton and Projects rows retain their open-request second-start prohibition; selected sprint/master Investigator rows admit separate requests under the shared capacity owner and retain each selected UUID through recovery and remount.
title: The launcher strip carries no execution prose and keeps the report one action away
